view: Seleucia on Tigris archaeological tell, very low viewpoint across weathered mudbrick room foundations and shallow excavation cut with scattered pottery fragments, flat tawny alluvial plain; no standing Greek temples or grand columns, no dramatic mountains.

eras.title: A city beneath the plain
eras.caption: Seleucia on the Tigris was founded as a Hellenistic royal city. Today its low mounds and excavated foundations offer a quieter view of that urban world, where streets and houses once extended across the Mesopotamian plain.
